# Shared Project Context

## Tech Stack
- TypeScript monorepo (pnpm workspaces): `@officexr/sdk` (headless), `@officexr/world` (renderer + physics + bots), `@officexr/studio` (React app)
- React + Three.js + `@react-three/fiber` + Rapier physics (`@dimforge/rapier3d-compat`)
- **Hard DIP rule**: no `three` or `react` imports in `packages/sdk` or `packages/core-refactor` — verified by grep; violations are build failures
- `import * as THREE` is banned outside `packages/*/renderer/**`

## Test Infrastructure
- **Unit framework**: Vitest — `pnpm --filter @officexr/world test` (or `cd packages/world && pnpm test`)
- **Unit file conventions**: `*.test.ts` alongside source (e.g. `src/bot/BotDriver.test.ts`, `src/bot/BotPool.respawn.test.ts`)
- **Rapier in unit tests**: requires global setup via `packages/world/src/__tests__/setup-rapier.ts` (already configured in `packages/world/vitest.config.ts`)
- **E2e framework**: Playwright — `pnpm test:e2e` at repo root; single spec: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/playwright/<spec>`
- **E2e conventions**: specs in `tests/playwright/*.spec.ts`; helpers in `tests/playwright/helpers.ts`; mugshot baselines in `tests/playwright/mugshot-baselines/`
- **After any renderer/physics change**: MUST run `pnpm exec playwright test tests/playwright/mugshot-*` and `tests/playwright/character-on-surface.spec.ts`

## Conventions
- SOLID by default — document any deliberate violation inline (which principle / why / what would remove it)
- Bot modes: one file per mode under `packages/world/src/bot/modes/`, registered in `BOT_MODE_STRATEGIES` table in `modes/index.ts` (OCP — add an entry, never branch on mode name in BotDriver)
- Physics constants + helpers: `packages/world/src/physics/rules.ts` — shared by `SceneFrame` and `BotDriver`; must remain headless (no Three, no React)
- Layout JSON: `packages/world/layouts/*.json` (schemaVersion 1, `commands` array of `placeObject` ops)
- Room JSON: `packages/world/rooms/*.json` (has `layoutName`, `commands`, `groups`)
- Map JSON: `packages/world/maps/*.json` (has `rooms[]`, `spawnPoints[]`, `environment`)
- Baked GLBs: `packages/world/baked-layouts/*.glb` — committed artifacts from `pnpm tsx packages/world/scripts/bake-layout.ts <name>`
- Window hooks for e2e: `__OFFICE_STORE__` (getState/setState), `__OFFICE_BOTS__` (setCount, setMode, respawnAll), `__OFFICE_MESH_DEBUG__`
- Honest physics — no magic Y offsets; if a character floats, the bug is in geometry/physics, not in an offset constant

## Key Files
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `packages/world/src/physics/rules.ts` | Shared physics constants + helpers (`GRAVITY`, `CHARACTER_CONTROLLER_SKIN`, `respawnThreshold`, `pickRespawnPosition`, `worldObjectsToCuboids`) |
| `packages/world/src/bot/BotDriver.ts` | Per-bot tick: mode dispatch -> physics step -> respawn check -> broadcast |
| `packages/world/src/bot/BotPhysicsWorld.ts` | Rapier world per bot: colliders, kinematic controller, peer mirrors, `step()`, `teleport()` |
| `packages/world/src/bot/BotPool.ts` | Dynamic cohort of BotDrivers; exposes `__OFFICE_BOTS__` window hook |
| `packages/world/src/bot/modes/types.ts` | `BotMode` union, `BotModeStrategy` interface, `ModeState`, `BotModeContext` |
| `packages/world/src/bot/modes/index.ts` | `BOT_MODE_STRATEGIES` registry — add new modes here |
| `packages/world/src/app/bake-optimizers.ts` | `BAKE_OPTIMIZERS` map — ids: `default`, `simplify-light`, `simplify-aggressive`, `none` |
| `packages/world/scripts/bake-layout.ts` | CLI: `pnpm tsx ... bake-layout.ts <name>` bakes a layout to GLB |
| `packages/world/maps/long_corridor.json` | Reference map (schemaVersion 1) |
| `packages/world/layouts/long_corridor.json` | Reference layout (schemaVersion 1, `placeObject` commands) |
| `packages/world/rooms/platform.json` | Reference room (has `layoutName`, `commands`, `groups`) |
| `tests/playwright/debug-character-grounded.spec.ts` | Reference e2e: `__OFFICE_STORE__` injection + numeric waitForFunction pattern |
| `tests/playwright/helpers.ts` | `waitForCanvasReady`, shared e2e utilities |
